11: 11 is the number of players in an American football team on the field at one time during play.
12: 12 is the number of constellations in the ecliptic (or signs of the zodiac).
13: 13 is the speed of rush hour traffic on average in kilometres per hour in London.
14: 14 is the number of pieces the body of Osiris was torn into by his fratricidal brother Set.

16: 16 is the minimum age for getting an adult job in most states and provinces across the globe.

18: 18 is the number of levels in hell in the Chinese mythos.
19: 19 is the final year a person is a teenager.
20: 20 is the number of baby teeth in the deciduous dentition.
